en.text: Relevant character names from the game.
If you have any questions or other problems, please post them in the comments.
Let's take out the Pigeon Lady.
Let's take out the Chess Player.
Let's take out the Test Pilot.
Let's take out the Rat King.
Grey Talon, I can heal you!
Check out what The Doorman bought.
I'm not ready for a team fight
Check out what Grey Talon bought.
They put up quite the fight.
It's time to kill a god.
You have no idea what I'm capable of.
A coward dies many deaths… the valiant only one.
Ready to lay waste to them.
I'm ready to give them hell.
They will feel the extent of my power…
I'm ready for a team fight.
That man fights like a demon. That's... fairly unsurprising, actually.
They took out the Pigeon Lady!
Our defenses will take care of them…
They took out the Chess Guy!
They didn’t see that coming, did they…
They took out the Test Pilot!
Haze made short work of them all.
I could learn from watching her…
Now that was some finesse, Haze.
Your training served you well, Haze.
They never even saw that coming…
You made short work of the objective, Infernus…
You kept me in the fight, Kelvin…
I knew I could count on you, Kelvin…
I'm in debt to a giant mole…
They couldn't be happy about that….
I don't know where you are, Talon, but thank you…
They took out the Rat King!
He just dances between them effortlessly.
Looks like he's not a fop after all…
We make a good team, Ivy…
I never thought I'd be grateful for being stuck in a cube.
I thought I was dead for sure…
Thanks for the set up, Wraith.
If I must die, I'll take you with me!
We didn't come this far just to fail now!
Ready to make my powers stronger…
I can't forget to improve my abilities.
I should check in with my allies…
What's life without a little risk…
For a moment I was worried.
We can't make any more mistakes…
This is closer than I was expecting…
I'm not feeling good about this…
It'll be tough, but we can still win this…
This is slipping through our grasp…
When we work together, anything is possible!
One of us isn't leaving here…
The battle ends when I say it ends…
There's still fight left in me…
You need to be faster than that, friend…
You opened yourself up for that…
Reposition me all you like, the result is the same.
Your little time tricks were never going to be enough.
You think you had the advantage there, Paradox?
You don’t have enough turrets to stop me…
These machines the best you can muster?
Plant all the turrets you want, McGinnis, I'll destroy them all
Be careful, they have the Rejuvenator.
They picked up the Rejuvenator, and they're going to mount an offensive.
I can't be caught in that electrical storm…
I need to get out of here!
I expected more from you, Haze…
You can't hide from me, Haze.
You were never going to escape me…
vindicta's trying to take me out…
I need to find some cover…
vindicta has me in her sights…
There's no flying away from me…
You thought you were untouchable, didn't you, Vindicta?
You can't run from me, Kelvin…
There's nowhere to run to, Kelvin.
Grey Talon is on the hunt…
I need to look out for that owl…
I can't let Grey Talon catch me…
We need to keep this momentum!
They have to be around here.
I've trained my whole life for this moment…
Your will is strong, Detective, but not strong enough.
The will of man is stronger than any machine.
Go back to the scrapyard, Bebop.
To think I was worried about the Time Thief.
All your power, and you squander it on petty nonsense.
Paradox, if you applied yourself you might actually be dangerous.
Paradox… you masquerade as having a code, when really you are driven by nothing but ego.
Pride will only get you so far, Paradox.
I can't let you complete the ritual, Dynamo.
Man was never meant to play god, McGinnis…
McGinnis won't be bothering us for a while.
You're a monster, Seven… and I won't let your sins go unpunished.
No mercy awaits the likes of you, Seven…
We have nothing to fear from Seven.
You will pay for every life you took…
The OSIC is out of their depth.
Even you have your limits, Haze.
I won't be intimidated by you, Haze.
I don't care about your wealth, you bleed the same as anyone else…
Your vengeance is justified, Vindicta… but your time has long since passed.
I put the spirit to rest.
There was no escaping me, Vindicta…
You won't prey on my friends anymore…
I won't let you burn New York…
This plane is not your playground…
Kelvin should be out of our hair for a little while…
He'll be back sooner than I'd like…
The tunnel rats have been dealt with…
They thought they could have their way with us.
You mistake ego for competence, Lash.
You have met your better, Lash.
Stick to fighting town drunks, Lash.
I have no tolerance for bullies.
There's always someone more dangerous, Lash.
I can't let you succeed, Mirage.
You won't complete the ritual, Mirage!
Don't make me do this, Talon.
I looked up to you once.
How can you of all people align yourself with that thing?
Is this what the Baxter Society has turned into?
Spend less time on your hair and more time learning how to fight…
You look better. I fight better.
This war isn't meant for you, Pocket.
I believe you want to change the world for the better, Pocket… but you picked the wrong friends.
That case will be your undoing, Pocket.
Don't worry. I'll take care of that case for you.
You're meddling in things you don't understand, Ivy.
Who did you think you were fighting, Viscous?
I won't be one of your victims, Wraith…
Money won't keep you warm in the coffin, Wraith.
Wraith, picking a fight with me was a mistake…
I won't be consumed by you!
You won't feast on my allies!
This is the beginning of the end for the 7th Moon.
You fought with grace, Yamato… but that will only get you so far.
I won't let the 7th Moon get a foothold in New York.
This city is under my protection, Yamato!
One by one my enemies fall!
Not even the Patrons can stop me!
Don't feel bad, I've trained my whole life for this.
I'll give my life for the Cause… but first I'll take yours.
Who among you will stand and face me!
I'll hold the line until my fellows return…
I can't leave the battle unattended.
I need to help my friends.
The battle calls, and I answer…
I will meet them on the field!
I'll be back when I can…
You never were going to beat me.
They're cagey, I'll give them that…
It appears I have a worthy foe.
There may be too many of them.
Ahhh and so they've come for me…
Better I have it than them.
Changing the world doesn’t come cheap.
I'll put this to good use.
We have the Rejuvenator, and now we press the advantage!
I can't fail like my parents did…
We can't let the Patron win…
It's hard to hold onto hope…
Bullets are just going to bounce off!
I should pick up those souls.
The Patrons must be stopped… no matter the cost.
My family failed to protect this city once before… it cannot happen again.
I will make up for my parents' failures.
Too often people think of the benefits without ever considering the cost.
Humanity needs to be protected from itself.
The Patrons will herald the end of humanity if we let them.
If I die, so be it…
The stakes are high, and I will rise to the occasion.
This isn’t about good or evil. It's about survival.
I should take a look at what I can afford…
Might be time to go shopping.
I should stop by the shop.
The right purchase can shift the battle…
I can't let these souls go to waste…
I can afford anything at the shop…
No point in saving more souls.
The objective is all that matters.
We're one step closer to completing the ritual.
That was supposed to be my moment!
And so it has come down to me.
If this is to be the end, let me die on my feet.
That was a whole lot of buildup for a whole lot of nothing.
I won't lie, that was demoralizing.
There's still much I have to learn about the Patrons.
Now is not the time to fight…
I'm not ready to fight the Patrons…
I won't be Anvil Song's catspaw.
I won't act on behalf of Ambition Spark.
There will come a time for war… but not yet.
I only get one shot at this… and I'm not ready to take it.
These secrets have been handed down generation to generation.
I'll lead them from the front…
Now this is how you start a fight…
Ready to get in the fight…
They'll lose their will to fight.
Break their weapons… break their will.
If I'm not willing to charge into battle, how can I expect others to do the same?
Time to run through the fire…
My mettle will be tested… and I will not falter.
I do not shy away from conflict…
They will come for me, and I will be ready.
Control the battlefield, and you control the war.
They'll try to run. It won't go well for them.
First they panic, and then they die.
If they know what's good for them, they'll run.
Time to keep them on their toes…
They will try to kill me, and they will fail.
I will stride across the battlefield in glory!
I will never back down to the likes of them.
Today I stand before the mighty and make them kneel…
I will face their entire army alone if I have to.
I'm ready to hold the line.
I must fight, no matter the odds.
I will stand as a beacon for my allies.
You have no place to go…
Will you run, or will you fight?
This will end one way or another…
I'll take on all of you!
Never show fear, no matter the odds.
It's time to change the world…
In a few seconds, it will all be over…
Their power pales when compared to mine…
They will bleed and I will endure…
